whyForBowfishing: Below a dam, what a bowfisher needs to know is simple: is the dam releasing or generating right now, and when will that change. Moving water pulls fish to the tailrace and changes where they hold and how safe the boat is, and a posted schedule lets you plan the night around the next start or stop. Flow numbers are useful detail but secondary. The score asks: for dam lakes, does the Brain say releasing or not (never unknown), and when it changes, from real operator data, and does that match what the operators posted?
measurement: Domain capability score (Cortex scoring.md SC-02, SC-03): how far Sector can trust the Generation Brain's published dam release picture (status, measured release, the operator's schedule). Not operational health, not production readiness, not comparable with any other Brain's score.
question: Per dam lake, does the Generation Brain say whether the dam is releasing or generating now (never unknown) and when that changes, current, from sources Sector is allowed to read, with parsers proven on real responses, and has that matched the operators' own schedules over the pre-registered week (GENERATION_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5)?
unknownPolicy: Unknown counts against the Brain everywhere (owner rule 2026-11-23: nothing should show unknown). A lake, tile or field that is unknown, unavailable, blocked or abstained earns 0 and stays in every denominator. Unknown is never rewarded or excluded to make a share look better. Every per-lake share therefore divides by ONE fixed denominator, all the lakes the Brain is meant to cover; a lake with no state (blocked, never computed, errored) is in it and earns 0. A Brain-level fact that is not published scores 0 and lowers completeness: both count as 0, never as excluded. Filling an unknown with an estimate is worse still: it is an invented value, which the validation checks fail, so the only way to remove an unknown is real data. For Generation, a release status of UNKNOWN, and a dam lake with no published state, count against.
scope: Every per-lake share divides by all catalog dam lakes (/brains/generation.fleet.damLakeCount, 401 in catalog generation-dams-2026-11-22.1), and a dam counts only if its /lakes/{k}/states/generation is fresh at scoring time (freshness.freshUntil later than the moment the scorer runs). Unbound, permission-required and errored dams, and dams whose old state expired after a later error, earn 0. The 220 directory lakes without a dam are not in it. Schedule coverage uses the 39 schedule-posting lakes for numerator and denominator alike. Validation fleet-wide.

dimensions.label: Releasing / generating now: a known status
dimensions.fact: count of catalog dam lakes whose state is fresh (/lakes/{k}/states/generation.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time) and whose release.status is GENERATING, SPILLING, RELEASING or OFF / /brains/generation.fleet.damLakeCount
dimensions.why: Whether water is moving at the dam right now is the first thing a tailrace bowfisher needs; UNKNOWN answers nothing and counts against.
dimensions.note: Read from the state, not the lakeFleet slot, so freshness is judged at scoring time. A dam with no state, an expired state, or status UNKNOWN earns 0 and stays in the denominator. Discharge, turbine and spill numbers are secondary detail and are not scored separately.

dimensions.label: When it changes: operator schedule published where operators post one
dimensions.fact: count of dam lakes in groups TVA, TVA_CUMBERLAND or SWPA_USACE whose state is fresh (/lakes/{k}/states/generation.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time) and has a non-empty schedule.windows / (fleet.byGroup.TVA + fleet.byGroup.TVA_CUMBERLAND + fleet.byGroup.SWPA_USACE)
dimensions.note: Numerator and denominator are the same population: the schedule-posting groups (plan section 3, 39 lakes). A lake outside those groups never counts, so binding more measured-only CWMS or RISE lakes neither raises nor lowers this share. Access today: the TVA_CUMBERLAND projects are also read through the TVA API, and TVA's robots.txt disallows all automated access (reported by the #241 review, 2026-11-23; the D-G check in source_access.json is not yet recorded), so TVA and Cumberland schedules are currently unobtainable and those 24 lakes earn 0 here until a permitted source exists (TVA permission under D-G). SWPA (15 lakes) waits on its own access check. No proxy schedule is used.
dimensions.why: The next start or stop lets a bowfisher plan the night instead of guessing.

dimensions.label: Dam lakes with a published release picture
dimensions.fact: count of catalog dam lakes whose state is fresh (/lakes/{k}/states/generation.freshness.freshUntil > scoring time) and has kind OBSERVED or SCHEDULE_ONLY / /brains/generation.fleet.damLakeCount
dimensions.note: Moves only with new bindings on allowed sources AND a current state from them (GEN-BIND-001..003). A catalog entry, or an old state that has expired, does not count. Absorbs the former currency dimension: with freshness judged at scoring time for every dimension, a separate 'not stale' share measured the same thing twice.
dimensions.why: A dam lake with no release picture leaves the bowfisher guessing; it counts against.

validationStatusMeaning.newInThisDraft: The plan says PASS needs all five metrics and a FAIL is reported as a FAIL; it defines no partial tier. The PARTIAL tier and its 7.0 cap are new in this draft and need the owner's approval.
validationStatusMeaning.VALIDATED: All five pre-registered metrics PASS (hour agreement, transition latency, schedule fidelity, no invented values, freshness) over the 7-day window (>= 2 weekdays, >= 1 weekend day) on every lake with a schedule bound and readable, at least the 17 bound today.
validationStatusMeaning.PARTIAL: Some of the five metrics PASS and the rest are NOT YET SCORED (for example metrics 4 and 5, checked on every published state, pass before the week ends); none FAILED.
validationStatusMeaning.NOT_VALIDATED: Nothing scored yet, or ANY metric FAILED. A failed metric is never credited; the status stays NOT_VALIDATED until a new week, run under the same pre-registered thresholds, passes.
validationStatusMeaning.whoSetsIt: The validation record under docs/cortex/ (plan section 5) and the reviewed change that writes /validation/generation, never the scorer.

accessNote: TVA's robots.txt disallows all automated access (reported by the #241 review, 2026-11-23; recorded for D-G, not yet in the knowledge release). If D-G confirms it, TVA becomes PERMISSION_REQUIRED and the 17 lakes counted 'readable today' (all read through the TVA API) are not readable until TVA gives permission. The worked examples below state their access assumption.
freshnessAtScoringTime: Freshness at scoring time: every per-lake fact counts only if the lake's state is current WHEN THE SCORER RUNS, judged from a timestamp in the published state, never from a flag written at publish time. A lake whose state has expired (the Brain stopped updating it, it errored after an earlier publish, or it is now BLOCKED with an old state left behind) earns 0. Generation: /lakes/{k}/states/generation.freshness.freshUntil must be later than scoring time. That matters here because a dam that errors after an earlier publish keeps its old lakeFleet slot and state (generation_brain/publish.py writes the slot only for a lake it published this run), so the slot's status and stale flag alone would credit it indefinitely. freshUntil is already in the state (the plan's rule: a published value stays current at most until its source's stale ceiling; a schedule-only state at most 6 h); no runtime change is needed. A NOT_DUE dam keeps a valid freshUntil and still counts, as it should.
